verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented cold-start latency figures for Sandbox0. The only timing-related statement says resume 'takes time and requires available capacity', which gives no sub-second or few-second guarantee. Claiming sandboxes from snapshots and auto-resume are related lifecycle features, but neither documents startup speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start sandboxes with documented sub-second-to-few-second cold starts
